description: Every item on the Oakland Unified School District Board of Education General Consent Report, from Legistar, with plain-English summaries, classifications and dollar amounts checked in code. meetings/{meeting_key}.csv holds the rows of items.csv one meeting at a time. The JSON under ../published/ has the same data with full detail (history, checks, attachments).

licenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
licenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (summaries, classifications, vendor profiles; official Legistar text is public record)
